maria_marketing: Heads-up — final run-through for Thurs 11am PT launch webcast. Need sign-off on reg page, Zoom config, backup recording, and post-event lead routing.

jamie_ops: Thanks — can we confirm EU captioning vendor? Also backup RTMP in case Zoom dies.

simon_hosting: I've uploaded reg page copy to Airtable (https://airtable.com/shrLaunchCopy). Please check CTAs: 'Join live' vs 'Save your seat' — pick one. Also add a timezone selector.

devon_prod: Zoom settings proposal:
```settings
- Cloud recording: enabled (auto)
- Local recording: host laptop as backup
- Auto-start captions: enabled
- Join before host: off
- Interpretation: off (we'll use captions vendor)
- RTMP fallback: rtmp://backup.redwood.stream/live
```

maria_marketing: @simon_hosting thanks for copy. @jamie_ops who owns the backup laptop? Also need speaker names and headshots by EOD.

jamie_ops: I can bring the backup MacBook, will install OBS and set up RTMP key. @devon_prod can you confirm OBS encoder preset? :thumbsup: 

devon_prod: Encoder: H.264, 4000kbps, 30fps. Scene: single screen + lower-third. I'll drop the exact OBS json in the doc.

elyse_grow: Post-event plan: 1) Cloud recording -> transcribe with otter.ai + SRT export 2) Auto-clip top 3 moments via clipper job 3) Push registrants + attendees to HubSpot 'Launch-Webinar-2024' list 4) Send 'Thanks + replay' within 24h.

maria_marketing: Lead routing rules: registrant -> MQL if attended >= 20m or clicked CTA in replay. Send warm leads to @jamie_ops Slack channel; cold leads to nurture sequence.

simon_hosting: Checklist for live day: token checks (embed form), 2FA on Zoom account, caption provider phone #, and escalation matrix. I'll post matrix.

jamie_ops: Oncall runbook snippet (copy):
```text
If Zoom fails:
1) Enable RTMP fallback (OBS)
2) Start local recording and upload to S3 s3://redwood-events/launch
3) Notify #marketing with TL;DR and replay ETA
```

maria_marketing: :clap: Perfect. Final Q — are we good with EU data residency for recordings? @simon_hosting

simon_hosting: Yes, cloud recording region set to eu-west-1 for EU registrants; local backups encrypted and deleted after 30 days. All good.

zoombot: Recording started (cloud) — 11:02:13 PST.

maria_marketing: Thanks everyone — I'll send final checklist and timeline in this thread. :rocket:
